item.title: Severe T'Storm Watch issued for Quad Cities late Monday night - large hail possible
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Severe T'Storm Watch for the Quad Cities and surrounding areas for late Monday night and early Tuesday morning. The watch goes until 3 a.m. The biggest threat comes from large hail late tonight.
